questions.q: What was Amos's background, according to the first verse?
For three transgressions of Damascus, ____, I will not turn away its punishment.
For each nation condemned in this chapter, the LORD says he will send or kindle a fire.
What did Damascus do to Gilead?
options: Threshed it with instruments of iron

questions.q: To whom did Gaza and Tyre hand over whole communities as captives?
The LORD will roar from Zion... and the pastures of the shepherds will mourn, and ____.
questions.answer: the top of Carmel will wither
wrong: the cedars of Lebanon will fall
the streams of Jordan will fail
the fields of Sharon will burn

questions.q: Amos saw these words two years after the earthquake.
What covenant did Tyre fail to remember?
What sin is Edom condemned for?
options: Pursuing his brother with the sword
Burning the bones of a king

questions.q: For what did Israel sell the needy?
Judah is condemned for rejecting the LORD's law and not keeping his statutes.
They trample the heads of the poor ____ and deny justice to the oppressed.
questions.answer: into the dust of the earth
wrong: at the gates of the city

questions.q: What sin is Moab condemned for?
options: Burning the bones of Edom's king into lime

questions.q: What did Israel make the Nazirites do?
They lay themselves down beside every altar ____.
The LORD says he raised up some of Israel's young men to be kings.
How does the LORD describe the Amorite he destroyed?
options: Tall as cedars and strong as oaks
Swift as eagles and fierce as lions
Many as locusts and bold as bears
Hard as iron and proud as Lebanon

questions.q: Behold, I will crush you in your place, as a cart crushes that is ____.
What will the most courageous of the mighty do on that day?
Do two walk together, ____?
wrong: if one of them is lame

questions.q: What does Amos say the Lord GOD does before he acts?
options: Reveals his secret to the prophets
Sends a sign in the heavens
Warns the kings of the earth
Speaks through the priests at Bethel

questions.q: Amos says, "The lion has roared. Who will not fear?"
Because the LORD chose only Israel of all families of the earth, what will he do?
options: Punish them for all their sins

questions.q: The Lord GOD has spoken. ____?
What does a shepherd rescue from the mouth of the lion, as a picture of Israel's rescue?
options: Two legs or a piece of an ear
A whole lamb from its jaws

questions.q: The LORD says the horns of the altar in Jerusalem will be cut off.
Which houses does the LORD say will perish?
"Indeed they don't know to do right," says the LORD, "who hoard ____ in their palaces."
The palaces of which two places are called to witness the oppression in Samaria?
What does Amos call the women on the mountain of Samaria who oppress the poor?
Because I will do this to you, ____, Israel.
After each disaster the LORD sent, the chapter repeats, "yet you haven't returned to me."
What do these women tell their husbands?
What did the LORD give Israel in all their cities, along with lack of bread?
Go to Bethel, and sin; ____. Bring your sacrifices every morning.
The LORD sent rain equally on every city, but the people still ignored him.
What did the swarming locusts devour?
I have overthrown some of you, and you were like ____ plucked out of the fire.
The overthrow of which cities does the LORD compare to what he did to some of Israel?
But let justice roll on like rivers, and ____.
What does Amos say the day of the LORD will be?
options: A day of rest for Israel

questions.q: The LORD says he hates and despises Israel's feasts.
What picture describes the day of the LORD?
options: Fleeing a lion only to meet a bear
A thief breaking in at night

questions.q: Seek good, and not evil, ____; and so the LORD, the God of Armies, will be with you.
Which places are the people told not to seek?
The chapter says a city that sent out a hundred will have fifty left.
Whom do the people hate in the gate?
You who turn justice ____, and cast down righteousness to the earth!
Which stars are named as made by the one Israel should seek?
Against whom is the woe pronounced at the start of the chapter?
options: Those at ease in Zion and Samaria

questions.q: The rich lie on beds of ivory and eat lambs from the flock.
They drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the best oils, but they are not grieved ____.
wrong: for the poor at the gate

questions.q: Like whom do the idle rich invent instruments of music?
Therefore they will now go captive ____. The feasting and lounging will end.
questions.answer: with the first who go captive

questions.q: What does the LORD say he abhors?
The chapter says that if ten men remain in one house, they will survive.
Which question does Amos ask to show how unnatural Israel's injustice is?
options: Do horses run on the rocky crags?
Can a leopard change its spots?

questions.q: But you have turned justice into poison, and ____.
questions.answer: the fruit of righteousness into bitterness
wrong: the song of praise into wailing
the joy of feasts into mourning
the bread of life into ashes

questions.q: What does the survivor say when bodies are carried out of the house?
options: Hush! We must not mention the LORD's name
The LORD has struck this house

questions.q: What did the Lord hold in his hand as he stood beside the wall?
Which priest of Bethel opposed Amos?
Amos told Amaziah that he was a prophet and the son of a prophet.

items: A vision of locusts eating the grass
A vision of judgment by fire
A vision of the plumb line
Amaziah tells Amos to flee to Judah

questions.q: Lord GOD, forgive, I beg you! How could Jacob stand? ____.
Where did Amaziah tell Amos to go and prophesy instead?
The LORD relented after Amos pleaded with him about the locusts.
What was Amos's work before the LORD called him?
options: A herdsman and farmer of sycamore figs

questions.q: Don't prophesy again any more at Bethel; for it is ____, and it is a royal house!
What did Amaziah report that Amos was saying about Jeroboam?
options: He will die by the sword
He will be taken to Assyria
He will lose his throne to Judah
He will be struck with leprosy

questions.q: What did Amos see in the vision at the start of the chapter?
I will send a famine in the land, not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but ____.
The LORD says the end has come on his people Israel.
What did the greedy merchants want to be over so they could sell grain?
options: The new moon and the Sabbath

questions.q: Making the ephah small, and the shekel large, and dealing falsely ____.
wrong: in the gates of the city

questions.q: What will the LORD do to the sun in that day?
options: Cause it to go down at noon

questions.q: The LORD swore by his holy name that he would forget their works.
What will the mourning in that day be like?
options: The mourning for an only son

questions.q: They will wander from sea to sea, and from the north ____; they will run back and forth to seek the LORD's word.
Which oath do those who will fall and never rise again use?
options: As the queen of heaven lives

questions.q: Where did Amos see the Lord standing?
In that day I will raise up ____ who is fallen and close up its breaches.
The LORD promises his people will rebuild ruined cities and plant vineyards.
What will the LORD command to bite those who hide at the bottom of the sea?
I will sift the house of Israel among all the nations as grain is sifted in a sieve, yet ____ on the earth.
questions.answer: not the least kernel will fall

questions.q: To whom does the LORD compare the children of Israel?
The LORD says he will utterly destroy the house of Jacob.
From where did the LORD bring up the Philistines?
The plowman shall overtake the reaper, and ____ him who sows seed.
What do the sinners of the people say before they die by the sword?
options: Evil won't overtake nor meet us
The LORD does not see us
Let us eat and drink today
